title: A helper that calls a helper
prompt: Write `beep`, which prints "beep". Then write `double_beep`, which calls beep twice. `solve` should call double_beep once, and the output is two beeps.
hints: Any function can call any other function, not just solve.
double_beep is `func double_beep():` with `beep()` written twice inside it.
solve then only needs one line: `double_beep()`.

docs.name: print(value)
docs.what: Shows value in the output. Takes anything; returns nothing.
